newsitem.title: UK: P&O mulls container joint venture -paper.
newsitem.headline: P&O mulls container joint venture -paper.

text.p: Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co, the cruise liner-to-construction group, is considering a joint venture with an overseas container shipping group for its P&O Containers unit, the Sunday Times newspaper reported.
The paper said another possibility was the disposal of the division, which saw profits drop last year.

It said the joint venture option would enable P&O's chairman Lord Sterling to release cash from the containers business, leaving his company with a half share in "what would be an important new force in cargo shipping."
A spokesman for P&O declined to comment on the report.
"We just won't comment on that sort of speculation as a matter of policy," the spokesman told Reuters.
